bathAction.title: Wash crotch
bathAction.tooltip: Wash the crotch-breasts, under them and over the nipples.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(take)] the weight of [npc.her] [npc.breastsCrotch] in one hand and [npc.verb(wash)] under them and over the nipples with the other. Sweat, and anything else they were holding, rinses away. [npc.speech(Under them. They hold the heat, and the mess.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(cup)] [npc.her] [npc.breastsCrotch] and [npc.verb(let)] hot water run over the nipples, washing slowly. [npc.She] [npc.verb(let)] out [npc.a_moan+] and [npc.verb(keep)] [npc.her] hands where they are. [npc.speech(Sensitive. Keep the water on them.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(scrub)] [npc.her] [npc.breastsCrotch] clean, under them and over the nipples, then [npc.verb(rinse)] hard. [npc.speech(Off. I am not milking myself in the bath.)]
